title: WPCRL/2299/2018 of YOGENDRA SAINI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPCRL No.2299 of 2018
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Honíble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Bhatia, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
Mr. S.T. Bhardwaj, Deputy Advocate General,
for the State/respondent nos.1 to 3.
The petitioner seeks protection from this Court
for the reason that he had earlier filed the Public Interest
Litigation being WPPIL No.03 of 2018 for removal of
unauthorized encroachment in District Haridwar, in
which appropriate orders were passed for removal of
such unauthorized encroachment. Thereafter, the private
respondents who are very influential and powerful
persons in District Haridwar are threatening him and in
fact the life and liberty of the petitioner is in danger. The
petitioner is being constantly threatened by the private
respondents. The petitioner has fear of his life and in this
regard, the petitioner had already moved a representation
before the Senior Superintendent of Police, Haridwar.
At this stage, we do not think that protection is
required in this case by us, but considering the fact that
the petitioner has already moved a representation before
the Senior Superintendent of Police, Haridwar, we direct
the Senior Superintendent of Police, Haridwar to
consider the representation of the petitioner in
accordance with law and in case the Senior
Superintendent of Police, Haridwar feels that there is
actually a threat perception to the petitioner at the hands
of the private respondents, the Senior Superintendent of
Police, Haridwar shall pass appropriate orders therein.
In view thereof, the writ petition stands disposed.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.) (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 19.12.2018
